KBA.marking_scheme_defending: zonal (six in zones, two on man)

matchups.verdict: Confirmed: Northgate's balls in behind produced 1.33 xG and the opening goal; Kingsbridge held their line around 48.0 m in possession.
matchups.title: High line vs elite pace
matchups.expectation: Northgate's best route to goal. Each ball over the top is a big chance.

matchups.verdict: Confirmed: after the card Kingsbridge shifted play to their left, and the equaliser came from Nakamura-Brooks against the booked Quiroga.
matchups.title: Fast winger vs vulnerable right-back
matchups.expectation: Kingsbridge will target their left flank; card risk for Quiroga.

matchups.verdict: Kingsbridge pressed more intensely (PPDA 5.1 vs 11.1). The press did bite: Kingsbridge won the ball high 36 times (Northgate 6), and Northgate avoided playing out by going long from goal kicks (13.3% short; Saarinen 54.5% pass accuracy).
matchups.title: High press vs weak build-up
matchups.expectation: Kingsbridge win the ball high up; Northgate avoid playing out and go long.

matchups.verdict: Kovač found 6 receptions between the lines in 60 minutes; Kingsbridge needed width and crosses (23) to progress.
matchups.title: Creator between the lines vs compact block
matchups.expectation: Little space for Kovač; Kingsbridge depend on width and crosses.

matchups.verdict: Confirmed, and decisive: both yellows came in duels with Adeyemi-Clarke (the second stopping a break), and the red card changed the game.
matchups.title: Hot-headed anchor vs counter-attacks
matchups.expectation: Brannigan will have to commit fouls to stop counters. Card risk is high with a strict referee.

matchups.verdict: Set pieces were not decisive: 0.43 vs 0.23 set-piece xG, no set-piece goals.
matchups.title: Set pieces: zonal Kingsbridge vs aerial Northgate
matchups.expectation: Set pieces are Northgate's second route to goal. At the other end Achebe-Ward's marking is a target.

matchups.verdict: The benches decided the last half hour: every goal after the 60th minute came from a substitute (Diallo-Kerr, Moore-Asante), both assisted by substitutes.
matchups.title: Late fatigue
matchups.expectation: Both sides tire. Whoever's bench brings fresh energy decides the final 20 minutes.

substitutions.reason: Kovač is tired and does little defensively; with 10 men the centre has to be closed.
Kingsbridge have to go for it. A wing-back with a better cross replaces the full-back.
A target man for aerial balls; Visser is running on empty.

KBA.behaviour_when_behind_expected: Goes to a back three with wing-backs and an extra striker (done 3 times this season, one winner).
KBA.behaviour_when_ahead_expected: Keeps the ball, rarely drops deep.
KBA.followed_profile: Yes: went to a back three with an extra striker while trailing (75'), and it produced the equaliser.

substitutions.reason: Quiroga is on a yellow and was beaten repeatedly by Nakamura-Brooks; a second yellow was only a matter of time.
Moreau is tired after an hour of defending; Northgate want more quality on the ball.
Petrov's hold-up play matters less now that Northgate have more of the ball; Diallo-Kerr brings pace against tiring legs.
Adeyemi-Clarke has cramp; Northgate also want an extra centre-back against the aerial bombardment.

NGR.behaviour_when_behind_expected: Brings on an extra striker but keeps the 4-4-2.
NGR.behaviour_when_ahead_expected: Goes to a 5-4-1 with an extra centre-back (done 4 times this season).
NGR.followed_profile: Partly: switched to 4-3-3 to exploit the extra man (not in the usual profile), then to 5-4-1 at 2-2 to protect a point instead of a lead.

weather.summary: Dry, 13°C, light wind (11 km/h) from the west
weather.impact: No significant impact. A dry, firm pitch slightly favours fast ball circulation and the Kingsbridge passing game.

referee.name: Alan Ostrowski (fictional)
referee.style: Plays advantage a lot, lets physical duels go, strict on simulation and on tactical fouls that stop counter-attacks.
referee.impact: Good for Northgate's duels in midfield; risky for a hot-headed holding midfielder who has to stop counters.

stakes.summary: Matchday 9. Kingsbridge (4th) need a win to stay in touch with the top three. Northgate (9th) are unbeaten in four away games and would be happy with a point.
stakes.importance: high for Kingsbridge, medium for Northgate

home.previous_match: Cup round 3 away at Pellham Town on Wednesday, won on penalties after 120 minutes
home.load: high: 120 minutes three days ago, six starters played the full match

away.previous_match: League match on Saturday (1-1 vs Eastmoor United)
away.travel: 210 km by coach, arrived the evening before

head_to_head.note: Northgate scored on the counter; Kingsbridge won with a late set-piece header
Kingsbridge 71% possession, 0.9 xG against a low block

absences.impact: Holt is the fastest centre-back in the squad and normally covers for Dijkhuis. Without him the pairing is slower and the high line is riskier.
One less attacking option on the bench.

mental.summary: Confident: 4 wins and 2 draws in the last 6. Expected to win at home.
mental.behind_record: Struggle emotionally when behind: 2 red cards this season, both while trailing.
mental.pressure_handling: Good at home, nervous when chasing a result late.

bench.summary: A clear plan B in target man Moore-Asante and crossing wing-back Castellanos; a strong defensive midfielder (Achterberg). Little creativity apart from Eriksen.

absences.impact: First-choice centre-back and organiser. Okoro is now the only aerial back-up for the 5-4-1.

mental.summary: Resilient underdog, unbeaten in four away games, good at defending a lead.
mental.behind_record: Rarely come back from behind (1 point from losing positions).
mental.pressure_handling: Calm under pressure, but they fade late: 5 of their 10 goals conceded came after the 75th minute.

bench.summary: Halvorsen (creative midfielder) and Diallo-Kerr (pace) can change a game; Okoro for defending a lead. Little depth at full-back.

morale.note: Modelled team confidence (1.0 = neutral). Drives pass accuracy, foul risk and tempo. Model output, not a measurement.

definitions.progressive: Completed pass or carry that moves the ball at least 10 m and 25% closer to goal, ending beyond 40 m.
definitions.deep_completion: Completed pass (not a cross) ending within 20 m of the opponent's goal.
definitions.ppda: Opponent passes in their own 60% of the pitch divided by our tackles, interceptions and fouls in that zone.
definitions.field_tilt: Share of all final-third passes made by the team.
definitions.xgot: Post-shot xG for shots on target, based on placement in the goal mouth.
definitions.xt: Expected threat added by completed passes and carries, using a smooth location-value surface (approximation of a grid xT model).
definitions.high_turnover: Possession won within 42 m of the opponent's goal (x > 63).
definitions.counterpress_success: Share of open-play losses where the ball was won back within 5 seconds.
definitions.rest_defence: Average number of outfield players more than 15 m behind the ball and in their own half while attacking in the opponent's half.
definitions.between_lines: Receptions between the opponent's defensive line (deepest 4) and midfield line (next 4).
definitions.carry: Movement with the ball between a reception and the same player's next action (>= 3 m).
definitions.sprint: 1-second sample above 23.8 km/h; high-intensity run: entering > 19.8 km/h.
